summary: Iteration-6 REGRESSION PASS. User-reported bug 'app crashes as just closed as open' is FIXED. Verified there are no duplicate object keys in frontend/src/api/client.ts (grep confirms: borewellConsumption, hourlyPumpingVsLevel, levelVsRainfall each appear exactly once at lines 381/389/400 and new flowVsLevel at line 510; obsolete BorewellConsumption/LevelVsRainfallPoint/HourlyPumpingVsLevelPoint types are gone). Frontend cold-boot at https://field-data-viewer.preview.emergentagent.com (390x844) renders onboarding Slide 1 (Live Field Monitoring, testID onboarding-slide-live) WITHOUT any red-screen, unhandled JS exception or pageerror. Tapping Skip advances to /login where login-brand (lion + wordmark) + login-form + 5 chips ('Real-time data', '24 × 7', 'CGWA ready', 'SGWA ready', 'CPCB / SPCB ready') all render verbatim. Sign-in via testIDs login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button with admin@envirolytics.com / Admin@Envirolytics2026 lands on /dashboard where dashboard-screen mounts and shows real data: INSTRUMENTS=5, ONLINE=5, OFFLINE=0, ALERTS=0, INSTRUMENT MIX DWLR:1 + FLOWMETER:2, LIVE WEATHER 28.6°C humidity 87% wind 0.6 m/s — API calls via apiUrl() helper all return 200 (login POST /api/auth/login, GET /api/instruments, /api/flowmeter/latest, /api/auth/me). Navigation via /devices (5 devices listed with All/DWLR/Flowmeters/pH/TDS filter chips all present as testID devices-filter-{ph,tds,conductivity} count=1 each), /quality (water-quality-screen mounts, wq-item-stp-COD renders), /reports (reports-screen mounts), /alerts (alerts-screen mounts), /profile (profile-screen + delete-account-button visible), /admin/users (Envirolytics Admin card shows 'GOD' badge + 'No expiry · GOD mode' verbatim; 4 users total, 4 active), /admin/activations (mounts, no red screen) — all six protected routes load without crash. Tapping wq-item-stp-COD navigates to /wq/stp/COD, wq-trend-screen renders with 'STP · TREND' eyebrow, 'COD' header, 'NO DATA' amber pill, 'Waiting for the first reading… trend will build as data arrives.' empty-state, safe-range copy 'Safe range ≤ 250 mg/L'. Zero non-cosmetic console errors observed during full flow. Backend 4/4 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_regression_iter6.py: GET /api/ 200 {status:ok,service:envirolytics-mobile-backend}, GET /api/health 200 with int poll_interval_s, POST /api/admin/run-auto-deactivate 200 {status:scheduled}, POST /api/email-subscriptions weekly:true round-trips via GET. All items in review request confirmed: (1) apiUrl helper working across login+instruments+flowmeter, (2) flowmeter unit changes not crashing (devices screen renders 5 items), (3) totaliser field aliases don't crash devices screen, (4) UserProfile.view_permissions parses cleanly (dashboard renders after /auth/me), (5) exportUrl caps limit at 100_000 (verified in client.ts:487 `Math.min(params.limit, 100_000)`), (6) new endpoints scaffolded (lastData / certificates / instrumentPhotos / customerProfile / doAlertHistory / chlorineAlertHistory / dwlrDaily / waterQualityHistory / flowVsLevel / requestClientRecoveryOtp / verifyClientRecoveryOtp) all present in api object with correct authed<T>() wrapping and encodeURIComponent on path params. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none. The user-reported crash-on-open is definitively fixed and the full regression surface passes.

Not yet wired into any screen — as noted in the review request, this is expected.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Tab bar in (tabs)/_layout.tsx uses expo-router <Tabs.Screen> without testID attributes — Playwright cannot select tabs via [data-testid=tab-devices]. Use direct URL navigation instead: page.goto(BASE + '/devices' | '/quality' | '/reports' | '/alerts' | '/profile' | '/admin/users' | '/admin/activations'). Login testIDs are login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button (NOT login-email / login-password / login-submit). WQ trend routes are /wq/{group}/{param} e.g. /wq/stp/COD, /wq/do/DO_tank_1. To skip onboarding on a fresh browser session, click text=Skip on the first screen. Admin creds admin@envirolytics.com / Admin@Envirolytics2026 remain valid against monitor.envirolytics.in and the tenant has 5 instruments (2 flowmeters, 1 dwlr, 2 do-analyzers).
rca_of_issue: N/A — bug already fixed by main agent. This iteration validates the fix. RCA of ORIGINAL crash (from main agent's changelog): duplicate object literal keys (`borewellConsumption`, `hourlyPumpingVsLevel`, `levelVsRainfall`) were declared twice in frontend/src/api/client.ts when scaffolding new upstream methods — TypeScript compiled but Metro emitted an unresolved thenable at boot, crashing the RN webview on first render. Fix: keep the original strongly-typed originals, drop the shallow duplicates, add only the truly new flowVsLevel() method. Confirmed by grep that each of the 3 keys now appears exactly once. Live boot at https://field-data-viewer.preview.emergentagent.com renders onboarding→login→dashboard without any red screen or JS console error, definitively proving the crash is fixed.
